description: Lean heartbeats (maxHeartbeats units) of candidate elaboration, including the elaborator's own kernel checks, plus kernel replay in the validation run; not bounded by or comparable with validation.max_heartbeats. Engines that report them do so for successful checks only.

Lean heartbeats (maxHeartbeats units) of candidate elaboration, including the elaborator's own kernel checks, plus kernel replay in the extraction run; not bounded by or comparable with validation.max_heartbeats. Engines that report them do so for successful checks only. The extraction run repeats that check before it builds the graph, so this is a second reading of the validation work, not the cost of extraction; never add it to validation_heartbeats.
Recorded generation workflow wall time, including retries/backoff for the built-in provider; not model-only compute.

Container peak: the cgroup high-water mark of all memory charged to the container, page cache included (Docker). Never pooled with process RSS peaks; a peak recorded under another peak_memory_scope is invalid.

Process peak: a Lean process's peak resident set size, from peak_rss/max_rss fields of records that supply them; no runner of this harness records them (native runs record no peak: peak_memory_reason not_instrumented). Not the memory charged to a container. Never pooled with container peaks.
